skills.name: patterns
skills.description: Instinct Engine — scans recent sessions, journals, and decisions for recurring patterns and turns them into concrete captures (CLAUDE.md rules, concept notes, writing seeds, skill improvements). Run after a weekly review or whenever you sense a pattern hardening. Also runs semi-autonomously via session-end auto-detection triggers. Do NOT use for weekly/monthly journal reviews, daily journaling, or one-off decisions.
headings: Step 1: Gather recent signal (do this silently)
skills.description_zh: 扫描近期会话、日志及决策的重复模式，沉淀为CLAUDE.md规则、概念笔记、写作素材或技能改进，可在周回顾后或会话结束自动检测；不替代周期日志回顾或单次决策。
